sar.narrative:
Customer C07297 reported that a $482.12 online transaction (transaction 3476682) on card C07297-K1 was unauthorized. The transaction occurred on November 21, 2016 at 20:30:00 in billing region 264.0 for product code C. The device used in this transaction was identified as new to the account: Trident/7.0 Windows 7 Internet Explorer 11.0 running at 1920x1080 resolution on a desktop.

The suspicious activity consisted of four rapid online transactions on card C07297-K1 within a 30-minute window on November 21, 2016, beginning at 20:00:00 and concluding at 20:30:00. These four transactions totaled $1906.07: $478.95, $456.96, $488.04, and $482.12. The flagged transaction of $482.12 is more than four times the cardholder's median transaction amount of $58.98 based on a history of 261 transactions over the preceding six months across 37 billing regions.

The activity pattern matches card-not-present fraud using a new device at strength 0.73. Eight structurally similar cases retrieved from closed case memory in the same region were all confirmed fraud, with no false alarms. The total suspicious exposure identified is $1906.07 across the four-transaction episode. The bank has blocked the card and created an automated case with a recommendation to file a suspicious activity report.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.85 is at or above 0.85 with 4 independent pieces of evidence, which policy section 6 treats as sufficient to act.
